reference_selection: masked-gene recovery only, no function labels
candidate_filter: unmeasured, non-noise, variance>0.01, top 3000 atlas variance
gene_selection: primary residual_guided uses inner held-mouse OOF residual after the measured panel; raw_guided and atlas_variance are sensitivity comparators
random_control: same candidate pool, same N, independent per outer fold
multiple_N_control: for each selector compare its best deltaR2 with per-random-replicate max deltaR2 over the same N grid
